from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UnappropriatedProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's unappropriated profit figure from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the financial report")
    unappropriated_profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The unappropriated profit amount in numeric form")
    profit_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 元")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the unappropriated profit value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    unappropriated_profit_records: list[UnappropriatedProfitRecord]
